snippet.title: Freja | New Hero Gameplay Trailer | Overwatch 2
snippet.description:
The hunt begins with our newest Damage Hero, Freja!

Once Overwatch's most renowned search-and-rescue operative, Freja now hunts bounties with unmatched skill and explosive precision.

Armed with her signature Revdraw Crossbow and a highly mobile kit, Freja is a tactical nightmare for her opponents as she excels in both long-range and mid-air combat.

Try out Freja during her limited-time trial today through Mar 24 before her official arrival in Season 16 on April 22.

Overwatch 2 is free to play for everyone on console & PC!
